items.title: Gham zada saara ghar hai zainab ka
items.body:
Ghamzada saara ghar hai Zainab ka,
Aqri yeh safar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Peeto sar belche ki zarbat se,
Aqri yeh safar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Roti hai aake apne Bhai ko,
Har azakhana ghar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain Rasule Khuda barehna sar,
Berida jab se sar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haal sunte hi ashk behte hai,
Tazkera gham ashar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Har qadam par nayi musibat hai,
Berida haye sar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lene aati hai bhai ka pursa,
Majliso me guzar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Beto'n ki laash pe kiya sajda,
Ya Ali kya jigar hai Zainab ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh azadaro'n ka juloos 'Hassan',
Lashkare haq nagar hai Zainab ka...

items.title: Hai aale nabi me shore buka dunya se uthi umme kul
items.body:
Hai aale nabi me shore buka dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
maatam karo barpa ahle aza dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
darbaar me jisko jaana pada cheeni gayi jiske sar se rida
seh seh ke masaaeb wo dukhya dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhai ko apne roti rahi mu ashko se apna dhoti rahi
ek pal bhi na jisko chain mila dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai pa fida karne ke lie qaaliq ne jise bete na die
abbas bane jiska fidya dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
masroof rahi sheh ke gham me din jis ne guzaare maatam me
padhti rahi har dam jo nouha dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
tha noke sina par bhai ka sar , sar par nahi thi jiske chaadar
kyu'n kar na kare us par girya dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
<<DIVIDER>>
masroofe buka din raat rahi zainab ke jo har dam saath rahi
jo roti rahi bhai pa sada dunya se uthi umme kulsoom
